name: Container instance
summary: One or more containers scheduled directly on Azure Container Instances with no orchestrator, for a short-lived job or a single sidecar-paired process, placed inside a VNet subnet.
useWhen: You need to run a container for a batch job, CI runner or one-off task with no orchestrator overhead
You need the fastest possible container start with no environment or plan to provision first
avoidWhen: You need autoscaling, HTTP ingress or scale to zero on demand (use Container Apps)
You need a long-running production service (Container Apps or AKS fit better)
